notes: UDC page lists 2 state prisons (Utah State Correctional Facility, Salt Lake City; Central Utah Correctional Facility, Gunnison) plus 6 community correctional centers, with no addresses on the index page. agency: Virginia Department of Corrections (VADOC); layer by VGIN/VDEM
local_jails: yes: VGIN VA_Landmarks layer has 43 'Local Correctional Facility', 38 'Regional Correctional Facility' (source BOLRJ, Board of Local and Regional Jails) and 24 'Regional Juvenile Detention Facility' records, with addresses and X/Y
notes: VADOC page is static, server-rendered HTML, clean and microformat-like: ul.facilitiesCollection > li with p.body-bold (name), span.street-address, span.locality, span.postal-code. Counts: 36 facilities (10 Eastern, 15 Central, 11 Western), 5 CCAP community sites (communityOfficesCollection), plus P&P offices and admin. The official VGIN Landmarks FeatureServer layer 1 (PlaceType 'Criminal Justice Facility State', 52 records, fields LandmkName, Address, City, Zip, X, Y, LastCheck) has coordinates but includes closed sites (e.g. Dinwiddie Unit 27 '(Closed)', Augusta CC) and DJJ juvenile centers. Use it for coordinates and join on name.
